name: PlayTime
summary: Tracks game play time on Knulli.

notes: User-authorized experimental test package for TrimUI Smart Pro and MagicX Zero 28; this is not an upstream compatibility claim or a verified package.
A user reported successful install and launch on TrimUI Smart Pro, but tracking, relaunch, repair, adoption, and uninstall are not yet verified.
MagicX testing is authorized from confirmed Knulli, aarch64, 640x480, and SDL GameController runtime facts; package install and launch remain untested.
The manager restores execute permission only for the reviewed playtime binary and playtime.sh launcher.
PlayTime statistics remain outside the managed package directory under /userdata/system/configs/playtime.
The tagged UI derives its layout from the display size and falls back to 640x480. Accelerated SDL rendering and the MagicX controller remain real-device test requirements.

The release is Knulli-specific and ARM64, but this revision does not identify TrimUI Smart Pro or a minimum Knulli version.

Reviewed paths are /userdata/roms/tools/PlayTime, /userdata/roms/tools/gamelist.xml, /userdata/system/configs/playtime, and /userdata/system/scripts/playtime-hook.sh. The tagged launcher and binary use local files and do not download or execute remote code.
The tagged code uses runtime display dimensions with a 640x480 fallback and SDL GameController actions. MagicX accelerated rendering and controller behavior are not yet package-tested.
